en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), the Couple on the Taints (Āsavaduka).
Dependent on a state that is non-manifesting, non-reactive, and an *āsava*, there arises a state that is non-manifesting,
non-reactive, and not an *āsava*, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Dependent on a state that is non-manifesting, non-reactive, and an *āsava*,

there arises a state that is non-manifesting, with-reactive, and not an *āsava*, by way of root-condition …pe… dependent on a state that is non-manifesting, non-reactive, and an *āsava* … [and so forth].
States that are non-visible and non-reacting, yet not-outflows, and states that are neither non-visible nor non-reacting, yet not-outflows, arise by way of the root-condition.
(Abbreviated. Under the root-condition there are six; under the object-condition there are three ... [etc. ... under the non-disappearance-condition there are six.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-outflow, a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-outflow arises.

[It] arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*). Dependent on a non-manifesting, non-reactive, and not-outflow-dharma (*anidassana-appaṭigha-noāsava-dhamma*), a non-manifesting, reactive, and not-outflow-dharma arises by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a non-manifesting, non-reactive, and not-outflow-dharma, both a non-non-manifesting, reactive, and not-outflow-dharma and a non-manifesting, non-reactive, and not-outflow-dharma arise [by way of the root condition].
By way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root, three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance, three.
